UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile document storing basic account metadata.

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user.

lastLoginAt.description: Last sign-in timestamp. Must be FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserBook.title: UserBook
UserBook.description: Book saved or added by a user in the digital library.

id.description: Unique ID of the book entry.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

category.description: Category or topic classification of the book.

url.description: URL to the book's online reader / Shamila page.

notes.description: User notes or description of the book.

isFavorite.description: Flag indicating if book is marked as favorite.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile data accessible only by the owner.

/users/{userId}/books/{bookId}.description: User books and favorites, readable and writable only by the authenticated owner.
